{{Quote|We can't just separate and kill Tabb, but leaving them together puts both of them at risk.|Doctor Senya Velop of Rhire Medical Academy, on Dwuir's request to separate from his other head, Tabb|<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|life/1344_3.html|Troig Seeks Separation}}</ref>}}
'''Senya Velop''' was a medical [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who was working at the [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|Rhire Medical Academy]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]], a two-headed [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] named [[Dwuirsintabb]], who lived on his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Pollillus/Legends|Pollillus]], made headlines at [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] when one of the two heads, Dwuir, requested surgical separation from the other, Tabb, whom Dwuir claimed was [[Death/Legends|suicidal]]. Senya Velop commented on the story for HoloNet News; the doctor stated that [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] medical technology was not sufficient to allow both heads to survive a head-separation procedure, yet leaving the heads together left both at risk of death.
